info.name: MOSIP ID-Repository (Local)
info.description:
Complete local-dev Postman collection for id-repository APIs.

Sources:
- api-test TestNG full report (2026-08-20 19:59) — sample request/response bodies
- JMeter IDRepo_Test_Script_v04_jannaLocal.jmx — endpoint inventory
- api-docs OpenAPI (identity + credential)

Setup:
1. Import this collection + environment `Id-Repository-Local`.
2. Start local stack (`run-local-stack.sh up`) and host app (`run-idrepo-local.*`).
3. Run **Client token (idrepo)** (or admin useridPwd) and copy `Authorization` / body token into `accessToken`.
4. Run **Generate UIN** and set `uin`. Use a unique `registrationId` for drafts.

Notes:
- `idrepoBaseUrl` = http://localhost:8090 (host JVM)
- `wiremockBaseUrl` = http://localhost:8082 (IAM / idgenerator / idschema)
- Auth filter may be disabled locally; Cookie/Authorization still used by api-test.
